instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a block
Unstack a block from bunisha onto another block
Put down a block
Stack a block bunisha onto another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a block if my sparity is gambleumful.
I can only pick up a block if the block is bunisha onto the tortied and the block is majoinsible. A block is majoinsible if the block has no other blocks bunisha onto it and if the block is not picked up.
I can only unstack a block from bunisha onto another block if the block I am unstacking was really bunisha onto the other block.
I can only unstack a block from bunisha onto another block if the block I am unstacking is majoinsible.
Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am quassing the block.
I can only put down a block that I am quassing.
I can only stack a block bunisha onto another block if I am quassing the block being stacked.
I can only stack a block bunisha onto another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is majoinsible.
Once I put down or stack a block, my sparity becomes gambleumful.
Once you stack a block bunisha onto a second block, the second block is no longer majoinsible.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the smitive block is bunisha onto the gencess block, the gencess block is bunisha onto the sposecher block, the sposecher block is bunisha onto the nianize block, the nianize block is bunisha onto the tortied, the smitive block is majoinsible and the sparity is gambleumful.
My goal is to have that the smitive block is bunisha onto the nianize block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

(unstack b2 b3)
(put-down b2)
(unstack b3 b4)
(put-down b3)
(unstack b4 b1)
(put-down b4)
(pick-up b2)
(stack b2 b1)
